scripts.cloudflare:web:deploy: npx wrangler --cwd ./apps/website deploy && npx wrangler --cwd ./apps/website d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config .output/server/wrangler.json
scripts.cloudflare:web:deploy-preview: npx wrangler --cwd ./apps/website d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config .output/server/wrangler.json && npx wrangler --cwd ./apps/website versions upload --config .output/server/wrangler.json --preview-alias "${CLOUDFLARE_PREVIEW_ALIAS:?CLOUDFLARE_PREVIEW_ALIAS env var is required}"
